title: China consumer price growth weakens in June while producer inflation rises to near 4-year high

facts.claim: China's consumer price index rose 1% in June year-over-year, missing economist estimates of 1.1% growth and slowing from 1.2% in May
facts.subject: China
facts.magnitude: 1% YoY, down from 1.2% in prior month
facts.cause: Elevated energy costs and weak domestic demand suppressing consumer price pressure

facts.claim: China's producer price index jumped 4.1% year-over-year in June, marking the strongest growth since July 2022 and outpacing May's 3.9%
facts.subject: China
facts.cause: Higher commodity costs from Middle East conflict supply disruptions, growing demand for AI computing power pushing up tech equipment and semiconductor prices, and low-base effect from June 2022 deflationary comparison

facts.claim: China's core CPI rose 1% year-over-year in June, edging down from 1.1% in May
facts.subject: China
facts.cause: Subdued core inflation reflecting weak consumer demand despite some commodity cost pressures

facts.claim: Food prices in China declined 1.6% year-over-year in June, easing from a 1.7% fall in May
facts.subject: China
facts.cause: Seasonal food supply dynamics and subdued demand
